dedupe_keys.name: minute level dataset from a naturally ventilated building for benchmarking and learning based modeling

description: Minute-Level Dataset from a Naturally Ventilated Building for Benchmarking and Learning-Based Modeling is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Sunghwan Lim et al. This paper presents a one-year, one-minute interval dataset from HouseZero®, a naturally ventilated and ultra-low-energy building in Cambridge, MA, USA. Filtering techniques were developed to process millions of raw data points recorded from 190 sensors and meters installed throughout the building. Coverage: national (US); published in 2026. The formats are not stated in the sources read. The paper's page was read, but no repository address could be taken from its machine-readable metadata, so the record links to the article, whose Data Records section names where the data sit. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence of the data is not stated in the sources read (the paper itself is open access). Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
